why.AlreadyActed: You have already acted this turn.
why.OwnSide: That one is on your side.
why.TooCostly: It costs more HP than you have.
why.NothingToPerform: You carry no essence to perform.
why.NothingHere: There is nothing here for that.
why.NoTarget: No one in reach to aim at.
why.FullHp: Already at full HP: the heal would be wasted.

tiles.stage: The stage: one at a time. Perform here to score what you carry.
tiles.hub: A hub: rest here to heal.

hints.move: Click a lit square to walk there, or click yourself to stay.
hints.target: Click a red square to choose the target, or Back.
hints.act: Choose an action: attack, an ability, an item, or End turn.
hints.battle: Your pick: choose a blow (and whom to strike).
hints.fight: The fight goes on: watch the blows land.
hints.level: Level up: choose one of the cards.
hints.treasure: Turn one card over, then take what it gives.
hints.event: Choose what to do; the dice decide how it goes.
hints.watch: Their turn: watch, or press Skip to hurry it.

levelcards.hp: More health, now and from here on.
levelcards.defence: Every blow you take is softer.
levelcards.speed: Act earlier in later rounds' order.

abilityText.strike: In battle: a blow of {power} plus your Attack. Costs {cost} HP.
abilityText.shield: In battle: blocks {power} of every blow for the rest of it. Costs {cost} HP.
abilityText.heal: {where}: heals {power} HP, an ally up to {range} tiles away ({reach}). Costs {cost} HP.
abilityText.hit: On the board: strikes a foe up to {range} tiles away ({reach}) for {power} plus your Attack. Costs {cost} HP.
abilityText.firststrike: Always: you pick first in every round of a battle.
